change: Reuse completed grouped rate-family and grouped-ratio scans through one literal scalar comparison in a consumed subquery.
admission: A comparison with one vector and an immediate Number scalar, either side. Preparation propagates demand through its resolved vector edge. Runtime requires an existing interval-qualified group or certified grouped ratio through transparent parentheses, exact ReplayKey/boundaries and at most one Map crossing.
preserved: Fresh scalar-first evaluation, complete source-ordinal slices, filter absence versus bool zero, scalar-left vector value, duplicate/name/diagnostic behavior, ordinary arithmetic and logical sample ownership. A comparison outcome never certifies Group or Pair completion; preparation progress clears before final delivery.
excluded: Computed scalar expressions, arbitrary nested maps, comparisons inside ratio operands, raw-selector pair and histogram wrappers keep their prior evaluators. Existing direct/ratio/histogram paths remain qualified.
ownership: No production fields, layouts, new completion owner, mapping table, raw/value cache or implicit limits. Existing metadata can grow with series count; raw samples remain paged across both axes.
